The '''Wall Crawler Droid''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that traveled along walls.<ref name="Hint Book" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] defended its assigned area with a built in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]<ref name="SWNES" /> and [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="Hint Book" /> Wall Crawler Droids could be found on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="SWNES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wall Crawler Droid only appeared in the [[1991]] [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] within levels set on the Death Star and also in the ''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]'', which first named it. The book included a brief description of the droid, accompanied by an illustration of it that differed greatly from its appearance in game scenes.<ref name="Hint Book" />
